text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan has made it through her
first three
years remarkably well. She's
made a deep
impression on the hearts of
many and become an
official URA
mascot as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, while considering the next
goal that
Aston Machan and I should
work towards...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer. Did you hear?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: This.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It looks like Machan dolls have finally
reached
Umamusume stores across Asia.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I take a look at the picture she's
pointing at... and
see some Machan dolls
displayed for sale in a
store overseas.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Soon they'll expand beyond Asia, and
reach the
whole world.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The planning and development staff
really are
amazing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few days earlier...

text_block_list.name: URA Staff
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, I've been hoping there was
something I
could do for you since the
very first time we
spoke.

text_block_list.name: URA Staff
text_block_list.text:
It's incredibly rare for an Umamusume to
be as
enthusiastic about merchandising
as you! I was
delighted!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Mhm.

text_block_list.name: URA Staff
text_block_list.text:
I must admit I was relieved when your

merchandising venture proved
successful, but...

text_block_list.name: URA Staff
text_block_list.text:
Seeing you run in the Sprinters Stakes
the other
day was downright electrifying!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Wow.

text_block_list.name: URA Staff
text_block_list.text:
This is no time to be content with
products simply
reaching shelves. We
need to spread your
influence even
further!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Wow!

text_block_list.name: URA Staff
text_block_list.text:
What I'm saying is... I'd like to take this
project
overseas! The first step will be
neighboring
countries in Asia! What do
you think?!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: That sounds great!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad I went to talk with the URA
right after my
debut.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
There are so many Umamusume out
there. If it
weren't for the impression I
made back then, they
probably wouldn't
have made such an effort for
me.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
But there are still homes without any of
my
merchandise in them. We have a long
way to go.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Although... if all the merchandise that's
out there
now ends up in people's
hands...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I think things will be okay in the future.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan looks at the Machan doll
displayed
in the window.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's the very first official Machan
doll—the same
one she gave me a while
back, before the
Sprinters Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...What would you do, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
If you didn't need your doll anymore,
what would
you do with it?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, I'm not sure if such a day
would ever
come at all, but in that
hypothetical scenario...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'd clean it up and keep it somewhere I
know it
would be safe.
choice_data_list: I think they probably put it away.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
You'd clean it up and keep it somewhere
safe...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Hm. That's nice. Yes, please do that.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
As long as you don't lose it, you can use
it to go
back in time.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
People say that finding a mascot doll in
your
drawer brings back memories.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It'll help you remember that adorable
girl who
used to be so popular all those
years ago...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Basically, I'm talking about the distant
future,
when you're much older.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Basically, I'm talking about the distant
future,
when you're much older.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Even if you've forgotten everything, and
all your
memories have been replaced
with new ones...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: If you find this doll again, then I'm sure...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...Your old memories will come flooding
back.
And you'll remember the girl your
doll was based
on.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...Even if you can't remember her name,
or what
she actually looked like.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
You'll remember the days you spent with
her,
racing and training.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
You'll be able to remember all about
Machan.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...No. That's not quite right.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I want you to remember me.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: So, please do.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Good... It's a promise, then.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My memories of the time I spend with
Aston
Machan will stay with me, in a
neat little bundle.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today, tomorrow... and even into the
distant
future.
